作品：**AI Watch**——跑 openvela（NuttX）的智能腕表，硬件为立创·黄山派（SF32LB52）。核心是六轴传感器疑似跌倒检测（全屏 15 秒倒计时、可取消、超时上报），另有表盘/应用菜单、计步与活动识别、BLE GATT 手机互联（时间同步/提醒/AI 语音闭环）。

- **作品代码在 `contest2026_403_anpai/`**：

## 编译 / 烧录

**现役构建树是 `cmake_out/prod`**（Ninja，`-S nuttx`）。旧文档里的
`cmake_out/contest2026_403_ai_watch` / `cmake_out/ai_watch_ai_watch` 都不存在，别去找。

```bash
cd /home/ma/openvela-contest403
export PATH="/home/ma/bin:$PWD/prebuilts/tools/linux/x86_64:/usr/bin:$PATH"  # 容器禁 utimensat，靠 /home/ma/bin/touch 包装
export TMPDIR=/home/ma/tmp                                                   # /tmp 只有 10MB，汇编大文件会爆

cmake --build cmake_out/prod -j 12        # 日常增量（已配置过）
```

删掉构建树后重新配置（命令与缓存里的参数一致，可直接复制）：

```bash
cmake -G Ninja -S nuttx -B cmake_out/prod -DNUTTX_BUILD=y \
  -DBOARD_CONFIG="$PWD/vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_403_ai_watch/configs/ai_watch" \

```

- **不要加 `-Wno-error=return-mismatch`**：GCC 13.4 没这个选项（GCC 14 才有）。
- `./build.sh <board>/<config>` 是上游封装脚本，产出在 `out/<board>/<config>`，本项目日常不用。
- 黄山派（SF32LB52）烧录（路径必须绝对）：
  `sftool -c SF32LB52 -p /dev/ttyUSB0 -b 1000000 --before default_reset --after soft_reset write_flash <绝对路径>/nuttx.bin@0x12010000`
- 串口 1M 波特；上电直接进表盘。构建踩坑细节见 `.agents/skills/ai-watch-playbook/references/build-flash.md`。

  b) PA38（VSYS 检测）的 pinmux 和输出电平，可能落在射频供电相关的域上。
需要更多信息（代码片段、日志、链接脚本、内存布局）可以直接问我。

     5	## Introduction
     6	
     7	This directory provides openvela support for the SiFli **SF32LB52-DevKit-LCD**
     8	development board on the `dev-ai-contest-2026` branch.
     9	
    10	The DevKit-LCD shares the SF32LB52 wearable / IoT MCU and the same 1.85"
    11	390×450 CO5300 AMOLED panel + FT6146 capacitive touch as the
    12	[SF32LB52-LCHSPI-ULP](../sf32lb52_lchspi_ulp) reference and the
    13	[LCKFB Huangshan Pi](../lckfb_huangshan_pi) derivative, but it is laid
    14	out as a **bench-top development board, not a wearable**:
    15	
    16	- **No on-board battery / charger.** The AW32001 charger and the I2C2
    17	  charger bus that LCHSPI-ULP / Huangshan Pi populate are removed; the
    18	  board is USB-powered through the on-package USB CDC ACM device
    19	  (vendor ID `0x38F4`).
    20	- **Different LCD power topology.** `LCD_VADD_EN` is on **PA37** (vs
    21	  PA01 on LCHSPI-ULP), and PA01 is repurposed as `GPTIM1_CH4` for
    22	  backlight PWM. VSYS (PA38) / VCC_3V3 (PA26) software gates are
    23	  unused — those rails are always on.
    24	- **Pin-map shifts** to free up the AUDIO_PA_CTRL and KEY2 pads that
    25	  LCHSPI-ULP uses for I2C2: AUDIO_PA_CTRL → **PA10**, KEY2 → **PA11**,
    26	  touch IRQ → **PA31**, touch I2C1 SCL → **PA30** (vs PA37).
    27	- **A second debug UART** is wired out: UART2 RX = **PA20** / TX =
    28	  **PA27** (LCHSPI-ULP repurposes PA27 as TF-card detect).
    29	- **xTS-oriented default config.** LVGL is disabled by default; instead
    30	  the `nsh` defconfig enables the openvela testing-suite apps
    31	  (`getprime`, `scanftest`, `fstest`, `ramtest`, `cmocka`,
    32	  `testsuites`, `cm_mm_test`, `cm_sched_test`, `popen`, `pipe`, …) so
    33	  this board doubles as the SF32LB52 side of the **Vela xTS** rig.
    34	  LVGL can be re-enabled via `menuconfig` if a graphical demo is
    35	  needed.
    36	- **NOR filesystem partition** sits at flash offset `0x008A0000` on
    37	  this board (LCHSPI-ULP uses `0x009A0000`); the link-script XIP entry
    38	  (`0x12010000`) and the `sftool` flash workflow are otherwise
    39	  identical.
    40	
    41	The CO5300 panel-init race fixed in `vendor_sifli` commit `0a3cd0a` is
    42	shared with all three SF32LB52 boards via `boards/sf32lb52/drivers/lcd/`;
    43	no board-local workaround is required.
    44	
    45	For board hardware details, schematics and the official getting-started
    46	guide, see the upstream SiFli documentation:
    47	
    48	- [SF32LB52-DevKit-LCD Wiki](https://wiki.sifli.com/board/sf32lb52x/SF32LB52-DevKit-LCD.html)
    49	- [SF-DevKit-LCM-Adapter (LCD module adapter)](https://wiki.sifli.com/board/sf32lb52x/SF-DevKit-LCM-Adapter.html)
    50	- [SF32LB52-DevKit-LCD on 立创开源硬件平台 (oshwhub)](https://oshwhub.com/sifli/sf32lb52-devkit-lcd)
    51	- [SF32 auto-download / RTS reset design note](https://wiki.sifli.com/hardware/SF32-auto-download.html)
    52	
    53	> ⚠️ **Branch dependency**
    54	>
    55	> This board overlay only builds on the `dev-ai-contest-2026` branch of
    56	> `open-vela/nuttx` and `open-vela/vendor_sifli`. Building it from
    57	> `trunk` or `dev` will fail because the chip-side dependencies are not
    58	> yet upstream.

    sf32lb52_lckfb_huangshan_pi: clean up redundant LCD power-up sequence
    
    BSP_PIN_LCD() previously asserted LCD_VADD_EN (PA01) inline alongside
    the VSYS/VCC_3V3 power gates. This is the wrong layer — VADD_EN is a
    panel-power rail that should be driven by BSP_LCD_PowerUp() according
    to the panel reset sequence, not by the pinmux init that runs at
    board bringup before the LCD driver is even ready.
    
    Likewise BSP_LCD_PowerUp() ordered the 500us settle delay before
    BSP_PIN_LCD() configured the IO pads, so the delay was guarding the
    previous IO state instead of the new panel-power state.
    
      - bsp_pinmux.c: drop the inline 'BSP_GPIO_Set(1, 1, 1)' from BSP_PIN_LCD
        so VADD_EN is owned by BSP_LCD_PowerUp() exclusively.
      - bsp_lcd_tp.c: call BSP_PIN_LCD() first, *then* the 500us settle, then
        drive LCD_VADD_EN. This matches the SiFli SDK reference flow and
        avoids racing the panel reset against an undriven VADD_EN line.
    
    No functional change for the (working) charged-battery path; fixes
    panel power sequencing so unattended USB-only boots reach the same
    final state.

    51	commit `e0c069e`（`vendor/sifli`，本地，**未推送**）。
    52	
    53	### 它改的是什么
    54	
    55	`middleware/bluetooth/patch/sf32lb52/sf32lb52_lcpu_patch_exp.h` 里的
    56	`g_lcpu_patch_bin[]`，把第 `[1164..1171]` 共 8 个 word（16 条 Thumb 指令）
    57	替换成 `0xBF00BF00`（16 条 `NOP`）。
    58	
    59	被 NOP 掉的原指令，反汇编如下（这是**根因**，值得记住）：
    60	
    61	```asm
    62	mov.w  r6, #0x40000000     ; RFC 控制寄存器基址
    63	ldr    r0, [r6]
    64	orr.w  r0, r0, #0x40000    ; 拉高 bit18
    65	str    r0, [r6]            ; ─┐
    66	movs   r0, #5              ;  │ 一次完整的
    67	bl     <delay>             ;  │ RFC 复位脉冲
    68	ldr    r0, [r6]            ;  │
    69	bic.w  r0, r0, #0x40000    ;  │ 拉低
    70	str    r0, [r6]            ; ─┘
    71	movs   r0, #5
    72	bl     <delay>
    73	```
    74	
    75	即：厂商 blob 在 **BLE 连接路径**上会复位一次射频控制器。revid=3 的硅片上，
    76	这一次复位直接导致连接后 1–2 秒内 `Hardware error code 0`。NOP 掉它之后
    77	崩溃率从 78% 降到 0/4。

PA38 is configured as an HCPU GPIO and documented as the board’s VSYS power gate, not an RF/BT pin. Its chip pin-function table lists GPIO and peripheral functions but no RF function ([bf0_pin_const.c](/home/ma/openvela-contest403/vendor/sifli/chips/drivers/cmsis/sf32lb52x/bf0_pin_const.c:1006)). The board already enabled PA38 in `BSP_PIN_LCD()` before the change; the current diff moves that enable earlier within `BSP_PIN_Init()` and changes the idle pull-down to no-pull ([bsp_pinmux.c](/home/ma/openvela-contest403/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52/lckfb_huangshan_pi/src/bsp_pinmux.c:204)).

That makes a direct RF pinmux cause unlikely. An indirect power-sequencing effect cannot be ruled out from the available source alone. Restoring the pull-down and removing the early assertion is a clean A/B test while retaining the original later VSYS enable.
